subject: The 6AM workflow our top 1% uses
preview_text: Your picks might be missing this crucial step. See what power users do differently.
body_paragraphs: I was on the phone with a guy who’s up 34 units this month. He doesn’t chase tips. He doesn’t scroll form guides for hours. Every morning at 6AM, he opens Predictify and checks one specific screen. That’s it.

He told me, ‘The difference between losing and winning is knowing which variables matter right now.’ He doesn’t look at every race. He filters by confidence scores above 70% and checks the live track conditions for his track. That’s the workflow.

Our top 1% use the ‘Quick Scan’ feature—it’s hidden in the racecard view. Tap the filter icon, set confidence to ‘High’ only, and sort by track condition relevance. You’ll see three to five races that matter. Everything else is noise.
Open Predictify now and try it before tomorrow’s first race. It takes 30 seconds. P.S. The 3-day Premium trial unlocks the confidence filter—if you’re not using it, you’re betting blind.
P.S. One of those top users just told me he never bets a horse without checking the ‘Trainer at Track’ stat. That’s inside the speed ratings tab. Go see why.
